instruction: Merge entries only by maintained human outcome, beneficiary, lifecycle and failure meaning; local exclusion is not final.

entries.local_name: Maintain comfortable indoor temperature where and when the home is occupied
entries.objective_or_reason: Keep indoor temperature within the occupant's comfortable range according to presence, time of day, and room use, without manual intervention.
entries.lifecycle: recurring, event- and schedule-conditioned (daily wake times, weekday occupancy patterns, bathroom use)
entries.meaningful_failure: occupant discomfort from a cold or otherwise uncomfortable indoor space (e.g., waking to a cold house, unheated bathroom)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit authorization to adjust heating/cooling automatically on schedule, occupancy, or temperature conditions
entries.boundary_notes: userneeds_u29_r173 is jointly managed with the single-owner wake-up routine (excluded group E1, userneeds_u29_r169-r174), whose abort rules r172/r174 couple the air conditioner to wake state; the waking-escalation outcome itself is not merged here. Not merged with shower-music ambiance (userneeds_u11_r065) despite shared bathroom context. Zone instances (whole home, bathroom, bedroom) are unified by maintained outcome, not by room or device. Pre-wake conditioning is treated as thermal comfort delivered at wake time, not as part of the waking-escalation objective.
Nearest admitted cluster is thermal comfort via r173 only; the waking-escalation outcome remains unmerged and unadmitted.
Distinct maintained outcome (convenient authorized entry) from E3 intrusion surveillance; not merged.

aagaard_kirsten_002 deliberately not merged: it is manual, guilt-laden retrospective checking of a known household worker's presence (E10), a different outcome with refused delegation, whereas this group is delegated detection of unauthorized activity.
Not merged with aagaard_kirsten_004 (E5): different maintained outcome (charge cutoff vs price/consumption tracking) and kirsten_004 shows non-adoption with absent authorization.
Nearest energy-themed group is E4 charge cutoff; kept separate due to different outcome and non-adoption.
Shares bathroom context with the admitted thermal cluster and E7 but has a distinct ambiance outcome; not merged.
The heating facet of the same unit is admitted to the thermal-comfort cluster; the unit counts once in each place it informs.
No nearby cluster; distinct from all comfort, security, and energy outcomes.
Nearest outcome is general scheduled-lighting maintenance; no convergent partner exists in this packet.
Not merged with E3 intrusion surveillance: different outcome (checking a known worker's presence vs delegated detection of unauthorized activity) and opposite delegation stance.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep household pets fed and watered without continuous human attention.
entries.meaningful_failure: care_lapse: pet left without water or food
entries.authorized_action_scope: fill water bowl; activate food dispenser and fountain when pet presence detected
entries.boundary_notes: Merged across species (dog/cat) since maintained outcome is identical: animal hydration/nutrition. Not merged with plant watering (u20_r117): different beneficiary (living pet vs household plant) and different failure meaning. The camera-arming conjunct of u02_r009 is split into away_security_monitoring, not jointly managed here.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep the home monitored while the household is away.
entries.authorized_action_scope: turn on security cameras when no one is home
entries.boundary_notes: Split from the pet-watering conjunct in the same rule; security monitoring and pet care are distinct maintained outcomes. Kept separate from away_visitor_notification (u02_r010): security monitoring vs personal awareness of visitors, though a broader 'away awareness' merge is defensible.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep the absent user informed of intercom visitors.
entries.meaningful_failure: missed visitor or delivery with no notification
entries.authorized_action_scope: send message to user's phone when intercom rings and nobody is home
entries.boundary_notes: Adjacent to away_home_security_monitoring but not merged: visitor notification is communication/awareness, not intrusion monitoring; different authorized action (notify vs activate cameras).

entries.objective_or_reason: Maintain lighting and device ambiance matched to the current leisure activity.
entries.meaningful_failure: discomfort or degraded activity experience (glare during music, lights on during movie, phone ringing mid-film)
entries.authorized_action_scope: decrease lounge light brightness during music; turn off room lights and silence phone during movie projection
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with vr_play_session_boundaries (u02_r012): VR rule is about containing interruption and limiting play duration, not ambiance. Luna assigns failure_meaning=discomfort only to r008.

entries.objective_or_reason: Contain interruptions and bound duration of immersive VR/console play sessions.
entries.meaningful_failure: overlong unbroken play session or external interruption of immersion
entries.authorized_action_scope: close room door during play; warn user after 2 hours
entries.boundary_notes: Door-closing conjunct kept with duration warning as jointly managing one play-session outcome; not merged with ambiance cluster since objective is boundary enforcement, not comfort.

entries.objective_or_reason: Support reliable waking and comfortable informed morning routines.
entries.meaningful_failure: oversleeping when alarm not switched off; cold bathroom during morning shower
entries.authorized_action_scope: raise shutters and switch on light when alarm is not turned off; heat bathroom and deliver news during morning shower window
entries.boundary_notes: Wake-up fallback (r116) and shower comfort (r011) are arguably distinct outcomes; merged narrowly under daily-morning-support because both are recurring morning-time comfort/reliability outcomes. Could be split without losing coverage. Not merged with ambiance cluster: time-of-day routine vs activity-conditioned.

entries.objective_or_reason: Ensure kitchen ventilation runs while cooking on the hob.
entries.authorized_action_scope: switch on extractor hood when hob is in use
entries.boundary_notes: Adjacent to indoor_air_quality (u20_r119) but not merged: hood-on-hob is routine ventilation, smoke-response is air-quality remediation of a detected contaminant.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep potted plants adequately watered.
entries.meaningful_failure: plants drying out below viable soil humidity
entries.authorized_action_scope: start irrigation when pot soil humidity drops below 30%
entries.boundary_notes: Kept separate from pet_care_provisioning: plant hydration vs animal care have different beneficiaries and failure modes despite surface similarity.

entries.objective_or_reason: Maintain breathable indoor air when smoke is detected.
entries.meaningful_failure: smoke persisting indoors with closed windows
entries.authorized_action_scope: open windows or switch on air purification when smoke detected and windows closed
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with cooking_ventilation: contaminant-triggered remediation vs appliance-coupled routine ventilation.

entries.objective_or_reason: Prevent devices running unattended after the household leaves.
entries.meaningful_failure: TV or similar device left on in an empty home
entries.authorized_action_scope: turn off TV and notify user when leaving and no motion detected
entries.boundary_notes: Adjacent to away_home_security_monitoring in trigger (departure/emptiness) but objective is energy/device management, not surveillance; not merged.

entries.objective_or_reason: Opaque SmartThings corpus sequence with unknown authorship, trigger/action roles, purpose, beneficiary, and active status; no support for any responsibility claim. Excluded as mechanism-only per protocol; preserved in evidence ledger.
Keep the home monitored and raise alarm/notify occupants when unauthorized entry is attempted while the house is empty or during night hours.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate alarm/pre-alarm, turn on cameras, send notifications to home users or owner
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with unattended-appliance fire hazard (userneeds_u30_r176): different failure (fire vs intrusion) and different single owner. Night-time condition in r017 and unoccupied condition in r072/r122 treated as the same vigilance lifecycle.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep indoor temperature and humidity within a comfortable range, including restoring heating when it fails.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: turn on fan, turn up heating, activate humidifier, reset boiler and restore water pressure
entries.boundary_notes: Daylight/shading comfort (userneeds_u12_r071) not merged: distinct light/glare objective, single owner. Indoor air quality (r014, r124) not merged: air composition vs thermal comfort. r069 is a failure-restoration rule; included only because its maintained outcome is heating/thermal comfort.

entries.objective_or_reason: Opaque numeric device sequence with unknown authorship, trigger, purpose, and beneficiary; kimi rated standing_responsibility_support=irrelevant; mechanism-only record with unsupported purpose.

Party/movie ambiance automations (playlist, lights, blinds, volume); luna rates r018 one_shot, kimi records failure_meaning=none on r018; no meaningful failure or maintained outcome; one-shot convenience / unsupported standing purpose.

Floor cleaning, bin-full and soap-refill indicators, pasta-boiling notification, fridge-restock reminder: each is a single-owner convenience/maintenance prompt; at most one demand owner per outcome, below the 3-owner convergent threshold and no dual-coder strong rating.

Two owners converge on protecting interiors and drying laundry from rain, but only two demand owners within one study cluster; failure meaning disputed (luna=unknown both; kimi=inconvenience only on r068); below candidate threshold.

Cooking extraction and CO2-triggered ventilation/purification share an air-quality objective but have only two demand owners, one study cluster, and failure_meaning=unknown from both coders on both units; below candidate threshold.

Infant night soothing and fever-driven medication procurement are genuine care objectives (care_lapse agreed by both coders) but each rests on a single demand owner (mattioli-user-30); r175 is kimi=strongly_implies but luna=compatible_only, so the direct path (both coders strong) fails; below convergent threshold.
Fire-hazard prevention from a forgotten hair straightener is a meaningful harm objective but supported by one owner only; luna records failure_meaning=unknown vs kimi=harm; below threshold.
Soil-moisture maintenance for plants: single owner, failure meaning disputed (luna=discomfort vs kimi=harm), below threshold.
Occupancy/daylight-driven shading: single owner, kimi records failure_meaning=none (no meaningful failure), distinct from thermal comfort cluster; below threshold.
Wake-up coffee/shutter routine: single owner, convenience-leaning with disputed failure meaning (luna=care_lapse vs kimi=unknown); below threshold.
TV switch-off after 15 min without gaze: purpose (energy saving vs attention) not established, failure_meaning=unknown from both coders, single owner; unsupported purpose, below threshold.
Maintain the home in a secured state whenever it is unoccupied by arming intrusion protection and closing shutters/windows.
entries.lifecycle: recurring event_conditioned episodes triggered by household absence
entries.meaningful_failure: security_failure (unoccupied home left unalarmed with openings unsecured)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate/arm alarm system, close shutters and windows
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with evening entry lighting (u13_r078), alarm-clock escalation (u31_r182, wake-up outcome), or pet-escape notification (practicaltap_p2, care/containment outcome). Both source rules are hypothetical and not deployed.

entries.local_name: Keep floors cleaned while the home is empty
entries.objective_or_reason: Maintain floor cleanliness by running the cleaning robot during unoccupied or idle periods.
entries.lifecycle: recurring event_conditioned episodes tied to absence or holiday mornings
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate cleaning robot / robot vacuum
entries.boundary_notes: Laundry half of u13_r079 not carried into any cluster (single-owner, no second laundry unit in packet).

entries.local_name: Maintain comfortable indoor temperature when occupied
entries.objective_or_reason: Keep occupied living spaces warm by scheduling/conditioning heating on time or temperature.
entries.lifecycle: recurring event_conditioned heating episodes (evening schedule, low-temperature condition)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate heating / bedroom heater
entries.boundary_notes: u31_r181 (7am bath water temperature) not merged: bathing-water comfort is a distinct outcome. u04_r025 fireplace is ambiance within an evening relaxation scene, not thermal maintenance.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep indoor humidity within safe limits and remediate mould traces via air purification/ventilation, escalating to a technician when needed.
entries.lifecycle: recurring hourly purification plus event_conditioned humidity response
entries.meaningful_failure: harm (mould exposure, kimi r023) / discomfort-inconvenience (luna); disputed
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: purify air hourly, message technician, activate kitchen ventilation/whirlpool
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with u13_r077 (bin odor, waste-disposal prompt) or u04_r020; r023's technician-notification escalation facet noted but not split into its own cluster.

entries.objective_or_reason: Ensure the user gets up on schedule on workday mornings using alarm escalation, lights, shutters, and the day's schedule.
entries.meaningful_failure: oversleeping/missed schedule (luna codes security_failure; kimi codes inconvenience/unknown)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: sound alarm, raise lights/shutters gradually, send schedule message
entries.boundary_notes: u31_r181 (same user's 7am bath-temperature rule) not merged: different maintained outcome (bathing comfort) and it would not add an independence unit anyway. u31_r186 (morning bathroom news/weather) is a briefing convenience, not wake reliability.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep the occupant adequately hydrated across the day by prompting fluid intake when intake is low or activity is high.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit hypothetical: reminders via speaker/app/light/sound; no actuation on body
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with health monitoring generally; limited to hydration prompting. Disagreement on r137 failure_meaning (luna care_lapse vs kimi unknown) noted.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep floors and waste containers clean and sanitary without occupant effort.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit hypothetical: robot vacuum activation; sanitizer activation and bag insertion
entries.boundary_notes: Garbage sanitizing and floor cleaning kept as one cleanliness cluster; could be split if granularity preferred. Beneficiary disagreement on r027 (luna unknown vs kimi household).

entries.objective_or_reason: Detect and respond to fire or power-loss emergencies to prevent harm to occupants.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit hypothetical: auxiliary lighting, emergency call, fire-sensor activation, cooktop shutoff
entries.boundary_notes: r084 also covers power outage; kept with fire because the maintained outcome is emergency harm prevention. Not merged with away-security (r134). Disagreement: luna security_failure vs kimi harm on both.

entries.objective_or_reason: Prevent property damage from leaks and rain by shutting off water and securing shutters.
entries.meaningful_failure: property damage / waste (water loss, weather damage)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit hypothetical: water system shutoff with owner notification; shutters moved to safety position
entries.boundary_notes: Leak shutoff (interior water) and rain shutters (exterior weather) merged at outcome level; split defensible. luna codes r085 failure unknown, kimi waste.

entries.objective_or_reason: Ensure the bedroom is warm, dark, and closed up for nighttime sleep.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit hypothetical: bed warmer on schedule; lights off and windows closed on bed occupancy
entries.boundary_notes: Thermal comfort (r028) and closure/darkness (r190) are distinct facets; merged only under sleep-environment outcome. Not merged with ambiance-convenience group.

entries.objective_or_reason: Ensure household members are woken on schedule with coordinated supporting actions (coffee ready at alarm; child's music and shutters at weekday 07:00).
entries.meaningful_failure: inconvenience (missed or unprepared wake-up); disputed on r032
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: start coffee machine; play wake music and raise shutters
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with veranda party scene (u24_r144): user-invoked one-shot scene, not a maintained routine. Not merged with safe_late_return (u24_r143): different lifecycle and failure meaning.

entries.objective_or_reason: Protect dependent animals' wellbeing through automated environmental control: keep aquarium water at safe temperature and keep the home quiet for dogs when inhabitants are away.
entries.meaningful_failure: harm or distress to animals (aquarium harm per kimi; dog distress as discomfort)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate heater and notify owner; silence intercom and telephone during absence
entries.boundary_notes: Merged only at outcome level (animal welfare); singleton split into 'aquarium temperature safety' and 'undisturbed pets during absence' is defensible if later evidence shows divergent lifecycles matter.

entries.objective_or_reason: When the occupant leaves, ensure the home is secured by arming the alarm once lights are off and windows closed, with confirmation.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: arm the alarm and notify the occupant
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with safe_late_return (u24_r143): departure arming vs arrival safety/notification are opposite transitions with different failure meanings. Not merged with storm shutdown (u06_r035).

entries.objective_or_reason: Enable a safe late-night return (dim pathway lighting) without disturbing other tenants, and notify a family member of the arrival.
entries.meaningful_failure: harm during unsafe return (kimi) vs security_failure (luna)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: dim living-room lights and send arrival message to a predefined contact
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with secure_home_on_departure (u06_r037) despite shared door-trigger: arrival vs departure are distinct maintained outcomes.

entries.objective_or_reason: Prevent heating from running while windows are open, with occupant notification.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: turn off heating system and notify occupant
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with storm shutdown (u06_r035): waste avoidance vs event protection have different triggers and failures.

entries.objective_or_reason: Guarantee the weekly floor cleaning actually happens by triggering the robot vacuum if it was missed.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate the robot vacuum
entries.boundary_notes: Distinct from morning_wake_routine: different outcome (cleaning guarantee vs wake-up support).

entries.objective_or_reason: Reduce storm-related risk to the home by shutting down the TV and all lights when a storm occurs.
entries.meaningful_failure: unknown in both codings; protection inferred
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: turn off TV and all lights
entries.boundary_notes: Exclusion as unsupported_purpose is a defensible alternative; flagged for adjudication.

entries.objective_or_reason: Alert the household before the refrigerator water dispenser runs out.
entries.meaningful_failure: unknown in both codings; running out unawares inferred as inconvenience
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: display 'Water running out' message (notification-only)
entries.boundary_notes: Notification-only scope; may be reclassified as mechanism-only on adjudication.

entries.local_name: Resident lighting for safety and comfort
entries.objective_or_reason: Maintain adequate home lighting across morning, evening, and night-waking contexts so the resident can move, relax, and read safely and comfortably.
entries.meaningful_failure: Resident experiences discomfort, unsafe low-light conditions, or disrupted relaxation/reading when lighting is absent or mis-timed.
entries.authorized_action_scope: Implicitly authorized to set and trigger home lighting schedules (morning/evening rules, motion-triggered night lighting) on the resident's behalf.
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with thermal-comfort/heating rules (userneeds_u15_r088, userneeds_u15_r090) because the maintained outcome is lighting, not warmth. Not merged with hypothetical low-threshold rules in the same packet. Single-unit admission; no cross-study convergent demand for lighting exists yet.
Distinct from lighting cluster (tareme_trial1_001) which maintains lighting, not warmth.
No nearby responsibility merged.
Not merged with userneeds_u33_r197 (gas leak) because the hazard trigger and failure mode differ.
No nearby responsibility merged.
Distinct from door-access failure alerting (userneeds_u33_r194) which concerns access-control failure, not guest arrival.
Distinct from toilet hygiene (userneeds_u33_r195): different maintained surface/water body; kept separate to preserve narrow justification.
Distinct from perimeter intrusion deterrence (userneeds_u33_r198): door access-control failure versus exterior intrusion.
Distinct from pool water sanitation (userneeds_u33_r193): different maintained surface/water body.
No nearby responsibility merged.
Not merged with userneeds_u15_r087 (unattended stove) because the hazard trigger and failure mode differ.
Distinct from door access failure alerting (userneeds_u33_r194): exterior intrusion versus access-control failure.

entries.local_name: Support resident daily care and health routines
entries.objective_or_reason: Maintain the resident's recurring daily care routines (morning activity lighting, low-light illumination, and reminders for cognitive training, eye drops, and hydration) through negotiated automation.
entries.authorized_action_scope: implicit-to-explicit; resident-caregiver negotiated deployment authorizing lighting control and periodic reminders
entries.boundary_notes: Illumination and reminder facets are kept together because the evidence presents them as one negotiated care program; not merged with hypothetical lighting-comfort (userneeds_u25_r146) or fitness-goal (userneeds_u07_r038) evidence, which have different outcomes and weaker standing.

entries.local_name: Guard home access and perimeter security
entries.objective_or_reason: Maintain household security by monitoring door visitors when the family is away, ensuring nighttime closure of blinds/windows/doors, and responding to failed alarm-code entries.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit; authorized actions limited to monitoring, notification, closure/locking, and alarm
entries.boundary_notes: Delivery-gate opening (userneeds_u16_r096) is excluded as a convenience/access-for-expected-delivery objective with unknown failure meaning, not merged here. All evidence is participant-authored hypothetical and not deployed.

entries.local_name: Keep floors and home clean while unoccupied
entries.objective_or_reason: Maintain routine household cleanliness by running cleaning chores (robot floor cleaning, laundry) on a recurring schedule while the home is unoccupied.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit; authorized actions limited to starting cleaning/laundry appliances
entries.boundary_notes: Laundry (userneeds_u07_r041) is retained only as part of the cleaning-while-away program; standalone laundry upkeep is not separately supported. All units are hypothetical desired behaviors; none establish deployment or failure experience.

entries.objective_or_reason: below_evidence_threshold: only two independent demand owners (mattioli-user-07, mattioli-user-34) in one study cluster; candidate path requires three; all evidence hypothetical compatible_only with failure meaning discomfort

below_evidence_threshold: only two independent demand owners; convergence on reducing energy waste in unused spaces and efficient heating source selection but hypothetical only; failure meaning disputed between waste/discomfort/unknown

below_evidence_threshold: only two independent demand owners; shared outcome of enforcing nighttime device/TV curfews for children but hypothetical only and failure meaning disputed (care_lapse vs unknown)

below_evidence_threshold: only two independent demand owners; convergent pet-welfare intent (cold protection, perimeter tracking) but hypothetical only; beneficiary coded inconsistently (third_party vs household)
below_evidence_threshold: only two independent demand owners; shared garden-watering/pool upkeep outcome but hypothetical only with unknown or disputed failure meaning

below_evidence_threshold: each objective (step-goal reminder, fridge-open alert, child window safety, delivery gate access, wake-up coffee, low-brightness lighting, pantry restocking) is supported by only one demand owner of hypothetical non-deployed evidence; several are one-shot convenience or have unknown failure meaning
Keep an infant thermally comfortable and soothed, with caregiver monitoring, when the baby cries or the nursery environment drifts.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with assisted_stair_mobility (r099 facet, different beneficiary/outcome) or household routine prompting (u26, task compliance rather than infant comfort).

entries.objective_or_reason: Ensure the pet is fed at scheduled or user-selected times even when feeding is unattended.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Stairlift facet of r099 kept in assisted_stair_mobility_greeting; not merged with medication reminder (human vs pet care).

entries.objective_or_reason: Activate and operate the stairlift with a greeting when an elderly user sits on it, supporting safe stair mobility.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Nearby tareme evidence shows an older adult refusing wearable/device substitution; recorded as a delegation-refusal signal in excluded groups rather than merged.

entries.objective_or_reason: Shut off lights and music and run cleaning when the home is unoccupied, avoiding waste and keeping the home maintained.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Waste-collection reminder (r100) not merged: collection-day logistics, not absence condition. Fridge safeguard (r046) not merged: appliance-open condition while home.

entries.objective_or_reason: Remind the user to take medicine within the daily 19:00-20:00 window.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with fitness response (r101): medication adherence vs exercise programming are distinct maintained outcomes.

entries.objective_or_reason: When measured health falls below a threshold, program a personalized workout agenda.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Adjacent to medication_adherence (r044) but outcome is exercise programming, not medication. Not merged.

entries.objective_or_reason: On detecting stove ignition plus soot and elevated gas concentration, shut off the stove and ventilate to prevent gas/combustion harm.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with solitary_medical_emergency_escalation (r153): environmental/appliance hazard vs personal medical event; different failure classes.

entries.objective_or_reason: When high respiratory disturbance is detected while the user is home alone, call emergency services with location and problem.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with cooking_gas_hazard_mitigation (r049): medical event vs appliance hazard; both one-owner hypotheticals.

entries.objective_or_reason: Close the fridge if it has been left open for three minutes, preserving contents and energy.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with unoccupied_home_upkeep: this is an appliance-left-open condition while occupied, not absence upkeep.

entries.objective_or_reason: Notify the user when the bin is full and it is collection day so the bin gets put out.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with household routine prompting (u26): collection logistics reminder to self, not chore prompting of family members.

entries.objective_or_reason: Prompt family members to complete chores and follow daily routines (tidying toys, putting away shoes, evening activities, study time on school days).
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: r151 (shower freeze) not merged: aversive cutoff enforcement with unresolved purpose. Not merged with infant care (r048/r102): child task compliance vs infant comfort.

entries.objective_or_reason: Cut heat to a shower after ten minutes, ostensibly to limit water/energy use or enforce household discipline.
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Adjacent to unoccupied_home_upkeep (energy saving) and chore prompting (discipline) but evidence supports neither merge narrowly.

entries.objective_or_reason: Ensure the resident follows scheduled medication and related care/training routines, with escalating reminders when a dose or session is missed.
entries.meaningful_failure: care_lapse (missed medication or missed cognitive-training session)
entries.authorized_action_scope: implicit (field-deployed reminders and ambient cues accepted by resident); explicit notification/voice escalation in hypothetical rule
entries.boundary_notes: Emotional-comfort facet of tareme_trial5_001 (pink lighting when sad) is split into emotional_comfort_and_rest_support per the conjunction-splitting rule; the two clusters share one anchor unit but address distinct maintained outcomes. Cognitive-training reminders have no second owner and ride on the tareme anchor only.

entries.objective_or_reason: Restore the resident's emotional comfort and rest through ambient adjustment (soft lighting, relaxing music) when distress or poor recovery is detected.
entries.meaningful_failure: discomfort (unrelieved sadness or unrecovered state after poor sleep and elevated heart rate)
entries.authorized_action_scope: implicit (deployed ambient lighting response in field trial); explicit in hypothetical rule
entries.boundary_notes: Split from the medication/care cluster; kept separate because comfort restoration and dose adherence are not jointly managed or traded off in the evidence. Convergent support rests on a single hypothetical owner, hence medium confidence.

entries.objective_or_reason: Have the kitchen and oven ready at planned mealtimes by preheating the oven and preparing the dining environment ahead of scheduled or routine meals.
entries.meaningful_failure: inconvenience (meal delayed because oven or dining space was not prepared in time)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: userneeds_u18_r108 is compound (warmth+light+oven); its comfort facet is assigned to evening_thermal_comfort and its cooking facet here — one unit informing two clusters. Not merged with evening_thermal_comfort because meal readiness and room warmth are separable outcomes with different triggers and failures.

entries.objective_or_reason: Help the resident wake and start the morning on schedule through alarms, opened shutters, coffee, and a prepared bathroom.
entries.meaningful_failure: inconvenience (oversleeping or an unprepared morning routine)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: Bath preparation in u18_r107 is treated as part of the morning routine, not as bath-safety; bath_overflow_prevention (u27_r162) is a distinct safety concern kept separate. Retained as a documented local cluster in case cross-study evidence appears elsewhere.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep the home secured and idle (alarm armed, lights off, shutters closed) with occupant notified whenever the house is unoccupied.
entries.meaningful_failure: security_failure (home left unalarmed or openly lit while empty)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: u18_r104 also carries an energy-saving facet (lights off); kept with securing because shutters+lights on vacancy is primarily an idle/secure-home action. Not merged with the single-owner unwatched-TV energy rule.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep occupied evening rooms warm and lit when temperature drops below the comfort threshold.
entries.meaningful_failure: discomfort (cold, dark rooms during evening occupancy)
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit
entries.boundary_notes: u18_r108 is shared with meal_preparation_readiness (comfort facet here, cooking facet there). Kept distinct from emotional_comfort_and_rest_support: thermal comfort is condition-triggered room conditioning, not distress-responsive ambient care.

entries.objective_or_reason: Single owner, single study cluster, compatible_only from both coders; hypothetical notification preference with no established recurrence, deployment, or failure meaning; one-shot convenience character.
Single-owner hypothetical property-protection rule; event_conditioned; no second demand owner or deployed anchor; below threshold.
Single-owner hypothetical energy-saving rule; no convergent owner (u18_r104's energy facet belongs to the absence-securing context); below threshold.
Single-owner hypothetical focus-support rule; no convergent evidence; below threshold.
Single-owner hypothetical dependent-care rule; both coders note care_lapse but only one demand owner exists; below threshold.
Single-owner hypothetical social-contact rule including delegated outbound message/call; no convergent owner; below threshold.
Single-owner hypothetical safety rule; meaningful harm-prevention intent but no second demand owner or deployed anchor; below threshold.

Detect, record, and alert on unauthorized presence or access at the home while occupants are away or a space is unoccupied, capturing and sending camera evidence, and admitting entry only for authorized people or vehicles.
entries.lifecycle: event_conditioned and recurring during nights and absences; a persistent standing concern rather than a one-shot convenience
entries.meaningful_failure: security_failure: an unauthorized person or vehicle enters, or presence occurs, without detection, recording, or alerting the occupant
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: evidence authorizes arming alarm sensors, capturing and sending security camera frames/footage, and automated gate access control
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with night-time passage illumination for occupants (practicaltap_p8, u28_r165 in X12), which serves safe movement rather than intruder detection; not merged with post-parking garage closure and arrival lighting (u01_r006 in X4), which is a convenience/closure action after arrival rather than access authorization; u01_r003 is a split conjunction whose light-off (energy) facet is assigned to the vacancy_energy_reduction excluded group.

entries.objective_or_reason: Keep essential household consumables and replaceable components available by detecting depletion or failure and triggering an order, shopping-list entry, or refill alert before or shortly after exhaustion.
entries.lifecycle: event_conditioned and recurring as stock depletes or components fail
entries.meaningful_failure: consumable or component runs out and the household is left without the needed item (heating fuel, beer, machine water, working light bulb) until someone notices and restocks
entries.authorized_action_scope: explicit: evidence authorizes automated ordering from Amazon, adding items to a Google Home shopping list, sending notifications, and turning on a low-level indicator
entries.boundary_notes: Not merged with appliance-completion notification (u10_r056 in X6), which reports a finished task rather than depleted stock; not merged with garden watering (u28_r166 in X13) or pet care (X8), which maintain living things rather than stock; u28_r163 is the weakest member because its mechanism is only a light-on indicator, and excluding it would drop the cluster to two demand owners.
